title: Modeling of the Fourth-Generation Toyota Prius Traction Machine as the Reference for Future Designs

source.citation: M. Gierczynski, R. Jakubowski, E. Kupiec, M. Seredynski, M. Jaworski, L. M. Grzesiak, Energies 17(19):4796, 2024

related.use: The archive the files below came from (CC BY 4.0); downloaded with the user's standing approval for this run.
27HF1500 B-H table (cached as a cell listing).

related.citation: File S2: full machine geometry in vector format
related.use: Geometry check of the patterned pole.

related.citation: File S3: geometry of one pole in vector format
File S4: machine model in the Motor-CAD file format
related.use: Regions, materials, magnet directions and remanence, stacking factor. Read as text; its scripting sections are not run.

related.citation: File S5: flux and inductance maps of the machine

machine.topology: inner rotor, three magnets per pole (a V pair and a bar near the surface), 48 slots with eight hairpin conductors each, full-pitch distributed winding
machine.symmetry: One pole of eight (45 degrees) with antiperiodic radial ends and a sliding band in the gap that turns the rotor without remeshing; flux linkages times 8. dq quantities from the phase flux linkages, with the d-axis on the rotor's north-pole axis and the phase-A axis and sequence from the winding's own MMF.

components_map.part: stator and rotor laminations, pockets, magnets, slots and conductors
one-pole sector: antiperiodic ends, outer A = 0, sliding band in the gap

pole_pairs.quote: The machine has p = 4 pole pairs

rotor_inner_diameter_mm.note: File S3 draws the rotor bore at 23.5 mm radius, as here; File S2 draws it at 23.55 mm. The model uses File S3.

stator_length_mm.note: The 2D model's depth; Motor-CAD's Stator_Lam_Length is the same.

rotor_length_mm.note: Recorded; a 2D model has one depth.

turns_per_group.note: Eight groups of eight turns per phase, in series: one hairpin conductor is one turn side.

coil_span_slots.quote: The coil span equals y = 6 slots
coil_span_slots.note: Full pitch: every slot holds one phase.

magnet_temperature_C.quote: assume the machine temperature is equal to 40 ◦ C

magnet_br_paper_T.note: Recorded: the paper rounds the 40 C remanence; the model derives 1.253184 T from Motor-CAD's 20 C value and coefficient, the MagBrValue Motor-CAD's own magnet regions carry.

stacking_factor.reason: Motor-CAD records Stacking_Factor_Stator=0,97 and Stacking_Factor_Rotor=0,97 for the 27HF1500 laminations; that its electromagnetic FEA applies the factor (as FEMM's lamination fill does) is assumed.

steel_bh.note: The 27HF1500 table of File S1: its first 17 points (to 1.7 T) are the Motor-CAD model's own 27HF1500 table, and it continues to 3.05 T at 1e6 A/m.

shaft_bh.note: The shaft is Motor-CAD's Mild Steel (Material_Shaft_Active=Mild Steel).

shaft_material.note: The model's mild-steel material (shaft_bh); control shaft-air builds the shaft of air.

stator_contours.figure: File S3, one pole in vector format
stator_contours.scale_reference: drawing units are millimetres: the outer arc is at 107.5 mm (Dso/2) and the bore at 70.85 mm (Dsi/2)
stator_contours.note: Patterned eight times by 45 degrees (without the drawing's radial cuts at 0 and 45 degrees) it equals File S2 contour for contour. Endpoints within 10 micrometres are joined (12 pairs per pole differ by 1-8 micrometres in the drawing).

rotor_contours.figure: File S3, one pole in vector format
rotor_contours.scale_reference: drawing units are millimetres: the rotor surface is at 70.2 mm (Dro/2)
rotor_contours.note: As stator_contours; the rotor bore is at 23.5 mm.

contour_snap_mm.reason: Endpoint join distance; the drawing's smallest real feature is far larger.

fine_arc_deg.reason: Arcs at the rotor surface and stator bore in 0.31 mm segments, two element layers across the 0.65 mm gap.

min_arc_piece_mm.reason: No arc is cut into pieces shorter than this: the conductors' 0.2 mm corner fillets in 1 degree pieces gave the first mesh 3.35 million elements.

gap_air_mesh_mm.reason: Air of the gap and the slots (one connected region).

pocket_air_mesh_mm.reason: Air in the rotor pockets and holes.

magnet_br_T.note: 1.253184 T, Motor-CAD's MagBrValue for every magnet region.

gaps.item: which slots belong to which phase
gaps.note: Every slot holds one phase (span 6 = full pitch, q = 2); the model takes the star-of-slots layout and measures the phase-A axis and sequence from that layout's MMF, so any correct full-pitch layout gives the same dq quantities.

gaps.item: whether Motor-CAD's maps average over rotor position
gaps.note: Averaged over six positions across 60 electrical degrees; the first position alone is reported as a comparator.

gaps.item: whether Motor-CAD's FEA applies the 0.97 stacking factor
gaps.note: Applied as FEMM's lamination fill; control stacking-factor-1.
Motor-CAD computes maps at FE points and interpolates onto the 10 A grid; the chosen points are taken as given.

gaps.item: the magnet temperature of File S5's maps
gaps.affects: every flux linkage, about 0.12% per degree
gaps.note: Added after the first diagnostic solves. Section 3.1 assumes 40 C and Motor-CAD's Magnet_Temperature is 40, but the conditions of the map calculation are not stated; the model keeps 40 C and control magnet-20C shows the sensitivity.
Mild steel, Motor-CAD's Material_Shaft_Active; control shaft-air.

coverage.reproduced: d- and q-axis flux linkage at twelve points of Motor-CAD's maps (File S5), with torque from them and from the stress tensor as comparators.
coverage.not_reproduced: The measured torque against current angle (Fig. 9), the induced-voltage test (Fig. 5), the operating-point and efficiency maps (Files S6-S9) and losses.

geometry_checks.quantity: File S3 patterned eight times against File S2 (segments, arcs, nodes); checked on the full cross-section before the restructure
geometry_checks.note: Equal contour for contour (endpoints to 1e-5 mm) except the rotor bore: 23.5 mm in File S3 and Table 2, 23.55 mm in File S2.

geometry_checks.quantity: radii: stator outer, bore, rotor surface (mm)
regions of the one-pole model after labelling
geometry_checks.note: Every closed region has exactly one label, once contours are split where a magnet corner rests on a pocket edge; the sliding band itself is a hole. The full cross-section built before the restructure had 384 conductors, 81 air regions, 24 magnets, 2 steel regions and 1 shaft.

geometry_checks.quantity: phase-A axis, sequence and the d-axis at the first rotor position
